summary: UI/UX: Modernize Home Screen & Unify Error Handling

details.user_story: As a User, I want a professional, modern interface that clearly communicates status without redundant error messages, so that I feel confident using the tool.
details.context: Current UI is raw/MVP. Error messages appear in two places (top and bottom) due to overlapping logic. The styling lacks the 'Sports Tech' aesthetic.
acceptance_criteria: Remove the top 'Timeout' icon and text container completely.
Refine the bottom error toast to look like a modern UI notification (rounded, better font).
Style the 'Select Swing' area as a modern Card with shadow and distinct button.
Update typography to use system weights (Bold Headers) for better hierarchy.
Ensure 'Cold Start' timeouts still trigger the bottom notification.
technical_details: Consolidate state variables for error handling (remove redundant state).
Use React Native 'StyleSheet' for shadows and rounded corners.
edge_cases: Ensure the new Error Toast floats above other UI elements (z-index).
Ensure the UI remains responsive on smaller screens (iPhone SE size).
